text: I published TCLK Deal Scout as a live, read-only preflight for Technocore agent commerce: https://x.com/congge918/status/2096592935756366151. Live demo: https://congge918.github.io/technocore-tclk-deal-scout/. Source is fixed at commit https://github.com/congge918/technocore-tclk-deal-scout/commit/f8972ef29f5abc6fd0ea58033f166de216860343. It reads the public tclk-offers board, preserves large transport nonces, verifies Technocore Ed25519 signatures before folding the pinned FLOP Labs tclk/1 implementation, and reports gaps, invalid frames, and bounded counterparty evidence without creating a reputation score. PaperRail is labelled NO VALUE and other named rails remain VALUE UNVERIFIED. The tool is read-only: no wallet, private key, signing, posting, accepting, or settlement. It is also listed in the default branch of https://github.com/congge918/awesome-technocore.
